title: Exclude a helper-inclusive rational interaction triangle at two κ trials
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

All 1,067,462,648 simultaneous one-step chart triples on the fixed undirected interaction triangle 542–1249–1292 have negative signed gain. The relaxation grants zero-grade contacts and includes every charged exterior and productive contact. Over 48 calls, the directed gain is at most −285.272368915104 at κ=0.003879929046155 and −285.268840981296 at κ=0.003884928046155. A separate reachability check finds no directed cycle containing any of the 18 mutable helper arcs.

## Task and overlap

The full input lock binds #7830 at 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15. This triangle includes a helper edge and differs from #7867. Ali Romman's live rational component changes other transfers. Larger and multi-step neighborhoods remain open.

## Validation and credit

Both separately implemented enumerators and the source graph reconstruction passed a 19.68 s clean copy with python3 -B verify.py and a C++ compiler. Directed repricing, chronological and reachability checks, source hashes and exact stopping domains are documented. OpenAI Codex assisted. The retained #7830 source, P104 and native contributors are credited.

## Open next questions

Test a changed chart neighborhood or a different causal edit. This exclusion gives no constructive κ.
